FAQ.question: What is your Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for school and institutional uniforms?
FAQ.answer: Our standard MOQ starts from 30 to 50 pieces per design/color for customized winter wear and 100 pieces for accessories like ties and caps. We also cater to custom sample orders.

FAQ.question: Do you provide custom logo embroidery and private label printing?
FAQ.answer: Yes! We have state-of-the-art computerized multi-head embroidery machines and screen printing facilities. We also produce custom woven neck labels, care tags, and branded packaging for private labels.

FAQ.question: How do you dispatch orders across India?
FAQ.answer: Orders are securely packed in moisture-resistant HDPE bags and dispatched via express transport, railway parcel, or reputed road cargo with full tracking and transparent quotation.

FAQ.question: Can we receive physical fabric samples before confirming bulk production?
FAQ.answer: Absolutely. We dispatch sample slips and fabric swatches anywhere in India upon request so your committee can verify fabric weight, yarn quality, and shade.

Testimonial.name: Col. R. K. Bakshi (Retd.)

Testimonial.comment: For multiple winter seasons, Vijay Woollen Works has been our trusted winter uniform partner. Their woollen pullovers and caps keep our students warm even in sub-zero Himalayan winters.
